title: Vi-ExToxic Phase 4 SFT Bundle
subtitle: Private inputs and scripts for Vietnamese toxicity SFT
description: Private training package containing the phase 1 teacher-labeled archive and the Vi-ExToxic phase 4 Unsloth SFT scripts. The holdout labels are teacher-generated and intended for exploratory comparison.

resources.description: Phase 1 teacher-labeled training and holdout data archive.
Dependencies for installing the unpacked SFT package in a Kaggle Notebook.
Checksums for the data archive and training source files.
